name: tsa_listInvites
description: Returns every TSA.WorkerInvite, newest first, with a computed status: Registered (usedAt set), Expired (expiresAt passed), else Pending. Admin dashboard; the token is not returned. Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'listInvites' to [TSA].[tsa_listInvites]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

rowsets.name: Invites
rowsets.description: Zero or more rows ordered by createdAt DESC.

codeSmells.issue: SP body not wrapped in TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Read procedure with no TRY/CATCH: any runtime error (timeout, deadlock) becomes an unlogged raw 500 from the shim.

codeSmells.issue: Admin list readable without a key
codeSmells.detail: The client calls it by POST, but the shim lets a GET name it with no X-Api-Key, exposing officer names. Fix belongs in TsaApi.cs.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
